Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix the paired quick-pick panel only offering the exact option a partner already picked for single-select animation dropdowns with per-person poses (e.g. animation 316); it now offers every option in that dropdown so the other person can pick a different pose.
